scope: Worker Unix pathname/abstract bind, connect and accept; original accepted OFDs, resolved weak targets and internal event waits; actual task identity in factories.
method: Four processes each perform 1,000 checked connection or pair lifecycles, four Trames vCPUs, three unprofiled counterbalanced before/after repetitions. All compilation, FFI acceptance and local Linux CI finish before Mac timing. Native ARM64 Linux references are recollected after all host work has finished, using the identical static musl ELF on the existing six-vCPU machine. Listener creation, bind/listen and unlink are outside the session loop; client creation/connect/accept, alias, data, EOF and final endpoint close are inside. Pathname and abstract names use their original respective namespace semantics. Native macOS uses native Unix APIs and has no abstract-socket substitute. Different kernels, filesystem/API semantics and compiler targets make these contextual references, not a Firefox/whole-app/iPad or generally native-speed claim. Pair-loop difference is small and not claimed as significant.

validation.unchanged_acceptance: Unchanged VFS passing results reused after Linux-only task-identity and hot-entry factoring. Unchanged guest artifacts and unrelated CPU/memory/graphics acceptance reused.

implementation.paths: One common VFS resolver and actual shared pathname routing domain in the sealed private query island. Excluded paths defer before effects and retain the original full OFD/address for owner resolution.
implementation.bind: Exclusive insertion under original filesystem guard; no overwrite between checking and publication, EADDRINUSE for losers.
implementation.connect: Original client plus weak resolved target and original readiness source. Backlog waits cannot keep listener alive or follow a rebound address.
implementation.accept: One selected item and preflight under listener guard; actual hidden Files reservation; output/callbacks outside guard, publish only after output succeeds.
implementation.waits: Original typed Unix/IP retained calls; internal notifications for Unix and original host sources for IP. No new thread, bus, polling, global lock, ordinary-memory fence or extra native permission layer.
implementation.task_identity: DescriptorFactory receives DirectSyscalls task identity in either builder order. Captured effective credentials remain unchanged; child sockets no longer retain a stale parent PID.
implementation.hot_path: Ordinary byte entry keeps its existing path without an additional duplicate control-admission probe.

discovered_assumptions.observed: All retained sockets were classified as external host waits; adding Unix control waits exposed a missing host-wait-source panic and stalled the initial one-slot regression.
discovered_assumptions.fix: Classify by actual transport/event source; Unix waits use resource notifications, including headless runs without a host event hub.

discovered_assumptions.observed: Worker task identity was supplied to messages but not propagated into the captured descriptor factory, so forked Unix creation/connect could use an inherited parent identity.
discovered_assumptions.fix: Apply the same task identity in either builder order; verify PID plus original effective credentials through socketpair and connected peer credentials.

test_instruction_correction: Encode high-bit O_CLOEXEC with MOVZ shifted by 16 in the guest regression rather than the 16-bit-only helper. Bounded rounds observe completed task waits; production deadlines and instruction budgets are unchanged.
remaining: Addressed unpaired-datagram data I/O and associated retained waits
